installed.interaction_verification: Real reader-assistant modules and the production AI transport run against mocked HTTP failures in headless Chrome. No live AI service request or native Zotero click test was performed.

limits: The reader assistant and AI transport were tested with mocked HTTP failures. No live AI provider request was made.
Browser checks cover chat and summary errors in Chinese, English, and Korean. A native Zotero click test was not performed.
The audit uses fixture substitutions for errors built in source and a service/status/time matrix. It is not a proof that all possible UI states are translated.
Windows portable tests exclude bake.test.mjs because its Unix executable fixtures are incompatible. Thirty optional fixture checks were skipped.
HTTP 400 remains a provider request failure; this update changes its display language. It does not change the AI endpoint, model, key, or request body.
The ZotPoP package and its existing configuration were preserved.
